digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge git delivery (push.py, merge recovery)
propositions: Bridge git delivery abandons after ONE transport failure (TLS/DNS/timeout) instead of retrying, leaving unpushed commits lost on the runner.
The push.py classifier treats transport faults and policy declines identically as terminal on first failure, when transport faults are retriable but policy violations are not.
Transport retry budget must be bounded to 3 attempts total per leg with backoff (0.5s then 2.0s) to survive transient flakes without sitting on real outages.

Merge recovery legs (explicit fetch in _recover_non_fast_forward and promisor on-demand fetch in _merge_remote_under_lock) must both apply the same transport-retriable classifier and retry with backoff.
Policy declines and genuine merge conflicts must remain strictly terminal after one attempt, raising their respective reasons unchanged.
